problem.no_gh: GitHub CLI was not found. Install gh and sign in with gh auth login.
problem.signed_out: gh is not signed in. Run gh auth login in a terminal, then refresh.
problem.not_a_repo: This project folder is not a git repository.
problem.no_remote: This repository has no remote yet, so there is nothing on GitHub to show.
problem.not_github: The remote of this repository is not on github.com.
problem.rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit is used up. Refreshing resumes when it resets.
problem.offline: GitHub could not be reached. The last known state is shown.
problem.error: GitHub answered with an error. The last known state is shown.

minutes.label: minutes · {{month}}
minutes.note: Windows runners count double, macOS ten times. Pushes from agents wait for you.

reason.needs_scope: The gh token cannot read billing. Allow it with:
reason.not_available: GitHub does not show billing for {{owner}} to this account.
reason.error: GitHub did not answer the billing request.

unavailable.not_github: This remote is not on GitHub, so Crewyard cannot tell which commits are pushed. Push task branches with git.
unavailable.no_remote: This repository has no remote yet, so there is nowhere to push.
unavailable.not_a_repo: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nothing to push.
unavailable.other: The push queue could not be read right now. Refresh to try again.

push.label: Waiting to push
push.empty: Nothing waits. Every local commit is on GitHub.

worktrees.label: Worktrees
worktrees.staleLine: {{branch}} is merged and has no unpushed work.
worktrees.clean: No worktree is merged yet; all are still in use.

pulls.label: Pull requests
pulls.empty: No open pull requests and none merged in the last two weeks.

reviewed.wait: Waiting for review of this commit
reviewed.fail: Review is for another commit or asked for changes

gateTitle.questions_unknown: Crewyard could not read the open agent questions for this branch, so merging stays closed.
gateTitle.draft: Draft pull requests cannot be merged.

pulls.blocked: Every gate except your approval must pass first.
pulls.confirm: Merge #{{number}} with {{method}} at {{sha}}? Checks, freshness and questions are read again first.

mergeStateTitle.clean: GitHub reports this pull request as mergeable (CLEAN).
mergeStateTitle.has_hooks: GitHub reports this pull request as mergeable; the repo runs merge hooks (HAS_HOOKS).
mergeStateTitle.dirty: GitHub reports merge conflicts (DIRTY). Resolve them on the branch; merging stays closed until then.
mergeStateTitle.behind: The branch rules want it up to date with {{base}} (BEHIND). Update the branch; merging stays closed until then.
mergeStateTitle.blocked: Branch protection still needs something, such as a required review (BLOCKED). GitHub checks it again when you merge.
mergeStateTitle.unstable: A check that is not required is not passing (UNSTABLE). It does not hold the merge.
mergeStateTitle.draft: Draft pull requests cannot be merged.
mergeStateTitle.unknown: GitHub has not computed the merge state yet. Refresh in a moment; merging stays closed until it is known.

workflows.label: Workflow check
workflows.clean_one: The workflow follows your CI rules.
workflows.clean_other: All {{count}} workflows follow your CI rules.

rule.push_all_branches: push runs on branches other than main; check other branches through pull_request
rule.no_concurrency: no concurrency group, so a new push does not cancel the run it replaces
rule.no_timeout: no timeout-minutes, so a stuck job can burn minutes for up to six hours
rule.costly_runner_on_push: Windows or macOS runner on push or pull_request; run those on tags or workflow_dispatch
rule.schedule_private: schedule in a private repository spends minutes without a change
rule.parse_error: the file is not valid YAML

taskPull.label: Pull request
taskPull.empty: No code task is ready for review yet. A task shows up here once its crew finishes.

reviewed.wait: Waiting for review of this commit
reviewed.fail: Review is for another commit or asked for changes

taskPull.pushNote: Pushes once, never with force. Workflows on GitHub may start.
taskPull.openBlocked: Every item above must pass first.
taskPull.openConfirm: Open a pull request on GitHub from {{head}} into {{base}} at {{sha}}?

feedback.label: Feedback from GitHub
feedback.routing: Send failing checks and review comments to the agent
feedback.none: No failing checks or review comments yet.
feedback.off: Off for this project. Feedback stays on GitHub until you turn it on.
feedback.sendNote: The step that wrote this branch has finished. Sending continues it on the same profile.

cleanup.label: Worktree
cleanup.confirm: Remove this worktree folder? The branch {{branch}} stays in the repository.
cleanup.removed: The worktree folder was removed. The branch is still there.

block.not_merged: The branch is not merged yet.
block.unknown_to_git: Git does not list this folder as a worktree, so it is never removed from here.
block.unpushed: It has commits that are not on GitHub.
block.live_run: An agent is still working in it.

error.pull_busy: This pull request is already being opened.
error.pull_no_github: GitHub could not be read for this project.
error.pull_no_title: Give the pull request a title.
error.pull_no_branch: The task has no branch to open a pull request from.
error.pull_moved: The branch has new commits since you looked. Check it again.
error.pull_gate_closed: Not every item before a pull request passes any more.
error.worktree_busy: This worktree is already being removed.
error.feedback_busy: This feedback is already being sent.
error.feedback_no_owner: No step of this task owns the branch.
error.merge_dirty: GitHub reports conflicts with the base branch. Resolve them on the branch first.
error.merge_behind: The branch is behind its base and the branch rules require it up to date. Update it first.
